3D Max 2008 30 Day Trial Released

Andy CASA, UCL East

Autodesk have released the 30 Day trial of the new version of 3D Max - 3D Max 2008.

The evaluation version is an excellent way to give 3D Max a spin and we recommend it for any reader interested in 3D modelling.

Visit the Autodesk site for full details and download.

News picked up via CGarchitect while noticing their links to a couple of our articles which are of course most appreciated..
